ImageDescription.value: The Reynolds Gel Racer was launched in 2006. It was a gel pen with a transparent cap and body, and it was given the title, "The Long Writing Pen", and it had water-resistant and fade-proof ink. Following the launch of the Gel Racer, Reynolds launched the Racer Gel-II in 2009. The Reynolds Racer Gel-II was a smaller version of the Gel Racer, but it had a lot of body graphics. Later, the -II prefix was dropped from the Reynolds Racer Gel-II and it became "Reynolds Racer Gel".
